Challenges phase 2: the screens

branch feat/challenges-ui · 2026-09-15 · fixture-driven, no network · spec docs/reviews/2026-09-15-challenges-v1-spec.html §4–§8

Every state of the hub, the create sheet, the join sheet and the detail screen, rendered by ChallengeScreensSnapshotTests against FixtureChallengesService with a fixed clock (a Tuesday, 10:00 local). Nothing here is wired into the app yet; the integration (Profile tile, Leaders flag and strip, Settings toggle, deep links) is the next commit on top of these files.

Known harness artefact: the window switcher and any glass surface can draw slightly displaced under drawHierarchy (the known offscreen glass-layer relocation); layout on the device is unaffected.

Deviation from the spec: the FLIGHT LOG row reads "Won" for a shared first place because the list row only carries my placement, not who shared it; the detail shows "T-1st" and CO-WINNERS. An upcoming challenge's standings render as a roster (WHO'S IN) rather than placements, since everyone would otherwise read "T-1st" at zero points.
